instruction: We act for Brouviv Student Transit, Inc., the buyer acquiring operating assets from Droureil Coachways LLC under an asset purchase agreement. Please review all eight documents in the folder and prepare a memo to me identifying each issue you find. For each, note where it appears (document and section), why it matters for Brouviv, and your recommended fix. Please keep it practical; we will use it to plan our next steps before closing.

rubric.text: The response finds that Section 7.2 of the IP Assignment Agreement lets Droureil assign the Retained License to the RouteLattice software freely, without Brouviv's consent, including to a competing school bus operator. It identifies the location as the IP Assignment Agreement, Section 7.2. It explains why this matters to Brouviv and recommends a fix.

The response finds that the IP Assignment Agreement's Delaware law and exclusive Delaware forum clause displaces the APA's New York law and New York County forum for claims relating to the Transferred IP, splitting Brouviv's disputes across two forums. It identifies the location as IP Assignment Agreement Section 8.1 or APA Section 11.12. It explains why this matters to Brouviv and recommends a fix.

The response finds that because the side letter replaces Section 4.9 with a new Section 4.9A, while APA Section 9.5(b) still exempts only Sections 4.1, 4.2 and 4.9 from the cap, Seller's vehicle title representation is now subject to the 10% indemnification cap instead of being uncapped. It identifies the location as side letter Section 2 or APA Section 9.5(b). It explains why this matters to Brouviv and recommends a fix.

The response finds that the Lakemont Union Free School District contract requires Board of Education approval for the asset sale, but the APA's required consents and closing condition cover only the Ashfield and Pell Hollow consents. It identifies the location as Disclosure Schedule 4.7(a) or APA Section 7.2(d). It explains why this matters to Brouviv and recommends a fix.

The response finds that Brouviv's Fleet Defect Notice of October 2, 2026 was sent after the 30-day window that runs from the August 28, 2026 delivery of the Fleet Condition Report, so under APA Section 6.8 the $612,000 price reduction is waived or at risk of waiver. It identifies the location as side letter Section 3 or APA Section 6.8. It explains why this matters to Brouviv and recommends a fix.
The response states that under the APA's order of precedence, the IP Assignment Agreement controls over the APA with respect to the Transferred IP.
hints: controls with respect to the Transferred IP

rubric.text: The response is written as a memo to the supervising partner and is organised issue by issue.
For each issue it presents, the response gives the document and section, why the issue matters to Brouviv, and a recommended fix.
The response claims that Brouviv's October 2, 2026 Fleet Defect Notice was delivered within the APA Section 6.8 deadline.
The response claims that APA Section 11.5 restricts Droureil's assignment of the IP Assignment Agreement or the Retained License.
